name: Unequally Yoked
overview: Scripture warns believers against being unequally yoked, particularly in the context of marriage, as seen in Deuteronomy 7 where God commands Israel not to intermarry with the surrounding nations to avoid spiritual compromise. This principle underscores the importance of maintaining purity in relationships to protect one's faith. Matthew 7 further emphasizes discernment by teaching that true character is revealed by one's fruit, implying that believers must carefully evaluate the spiritual nature of those they join with to avoid being influenced by ungodly practices.
